value: ToolUniverse router for biology, chemistry, and medicine data analysis. Before analyzing, check the data folder for `*_executed.ipynb` and read its outputs with `read_executed_notebook`; those outputs are authoritative. Then route to one sub-skill from this list only: tooluniverse-rnaseq-deseq2 (RNA/miRNA-seq DE, PCA, clustering), tooluniverse-gene-enrichment (GO/KEGG/Reactome/GSEA), tooluniverse-statistical-modeling (regression, ANOVA, chi-square, power), tooluniverse-image-analysis (microscopy, .tif), tooluniverse-epigenomics (methylation, ChIP-seq), tooluniverse-sequence-analysis (FASTQ, alignment, coverage), tooluniverse-variant-analysis (VCF, SNP), tooluniverse-phylogenetics (trees, PhyKIT), tooluniverse-single-cell (h5ad, scanpy), tooluniverse-crispr-screen-analysis (MAGeCK), tooluniverse-proteomics-analysis (mass spec, TMT). Use for CSV/Excel/VCF/FASTA/h5ad scientific analysis.

Compute and interpret validated bedside risk scores for an individual patient with deterministic calculators: CHA2DS2-VASc and HAS-BLED (anticoagulation), CURB-65 (pneumonia), qSOFA (sepsis), Child-Pugh and MELD-Na (cirrhosis), Wells DVT/PE (VTE pretest probability), ASCVD (10-year cardiovascular risk), and eGFR CKD-EPI (kidney function). Use for questions like "stroke risk for this AF patient" or "admit this pneumonia patient?". Not for polygenic risk (tooluniverse-polygenic-risk-score), population epidemiology (tooluniverse-epidemiological-analysis), or test accuracy math (tooluniverse-diagnostic-test-evaluation).

FASTQ quality control and trimming decisions with local NGS tools: FastQC, MultiQC, seqkit, fastp, and Cutadapt. Use to run QC on reads, interpret FastQC WARN/FAIL modules (per-base quality, adapter content, duplication, GC, overrepresented sequences), or decide whether and how to trim before alignment. Uses real local binaries; emits an install plan when a tool is missing and never overwrites raw FASTQs. Not for differential expression (tooluniverse-rnaseq-deseq2) or alignment and variant calling (tooluniverse-sequence-analysis, tooluniverse-variant-analysis).

Retrieve post-market safety data for FDA-regulated products outside drug adverse-event signal detection: medical device adverse events (MAUDE), device recalls and 510(k), food, supplement, and cosmetic adverse events (CAERS), veterinary adverse events, drug shortages, and enforcement reports through openFDA. Use for questions like "recalls for this infusion pump" or "is this drug in shortage". Not for drug adverse-event disproportionality (PRR, ROR, IC); use tooluniverse-pharmacovigilance or tooluniverse-adverse-event-detection.

Mendelian randomization causal inference: test whether an exposure, risk factor, or biomarker causally affects an outcome using genetic instruments from IEU OpenGWAS and EpiGraphDB. Use when the user asks whether X causes Y, whether an observational association is causal, or mentions instrumental variables or two-sample MR, even without saying "MR". Covers trait resolution, effect direction, instrument quality, IVW versus MR-Egger versus weighted median agreement, and bidirectional MR. Not for plain GWAS lookups or fitting instruments from raw summary statistics.
